beta.notes:
Fixes:
• Manually assigned work samples are now preserved before incoming-file cleanup, preventing assigned samples from losing their source files.
• Windows installers now require a working browser connection helper, preventing an installation from silently missing the connection needed by the PCA extension.
• Crash reports now remove personal information before upload, and browser connection diagnostics better identify failed requests.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
